_help: All site text lives here. Edit, then run: python3 build.py && python3 build.py --check. See README.md.
name: More Match Points
_name_help: Brand name: header wordmark, page titles, share image, manifest, footer and the search listing. Lucas is listed as the coach.
_base_help: Full site address with no trailing slash (custom domain morematchpoints.com, set in the repo's Pages settings; build.py writes the CNAME file from this).
title: More Match Points | Private Tennis Lessons in Middlebury & Southbury, CT
description: More Match Points: 1-on-1 private tennis lessons with PTR Certified instructor Lucas Oskwarek. $35 per 1-hour lesson, flexible scheduling, all skill levels. Serving Middlebury, Southbury and Greater Waterbury, CT.
tagline: Take your game to the next level.
intro: Looking to take your game to the next level? Get a fresh perspective on your technique.
_price_help: Lesson price in whole US dollars. Changes the price card, the share description and the search listing (priceRange). Also update the $35 in "description" above.

_experience_help: Experience cards (flyer + resume wording). tag = small label, leave "when" empty to hide the date.
_area_help: areas = what visitors see. area_cities = town names given to search engines (areaServed).
form_subject: New lesson request - More Match Points
_form_help: POST endpoint for the lesson request form (FormSubmit). Can be swapped for FormSubmit's random-string alias (https://formsubmit.co/<alias>) after activation. FormSubmit sends a one-time activation email to the address on the first real submission; someone must click Activate before requests arrive. null = the form is hidden and visitors use call/text/email.
book_text: Send a lesson request with your preferred times and skill level, and Lucas will get back to you to set up your first lesson.
_book_help: The lesson request form is the only contact method on the site (no phone or email is published).
footer_line: Private tennis lessons with Lucas Oskwarek, PTR Certified
_hero_help: hero_lines: the big headline, one entry per line (same words as tagline). hero_highlight = how many of the last lines are optic yellow.
_hero_photo_help: Action photo for the hero. null = the court illustration. To use a real photo: put it at images/lucas-action.jpg (about 1200x1400, portrait, under 300 KB), set hero_photo to "images/lucas-action.jpg" and write a short hero_photo_alt, then rebuild. See README.
